exclude: decoration on fits or fastener seats
heightmap outside the localized optional insert

assembly_sequence: Confirm the measured site, wall substrate, purchased hardware, and process-matched coupons before production assembly.
Assemble seven M4-locked frame segments per side and engage each side frame with its two PETG feet and TPU floor pads.
Install shelf brackets at the selected frame positions for shelf top datums Z=1050 mm and Z=1400 mm.
Assemble three tiles and underside joiners for each shelf, then fasten each shelf to its brackets.
Install six-column modules; center-split any wider-than-245 mm three-column module and use only coupon-qualified M3 seam hardware.
Install the replaceable fascias, header, and optional localized heightmap insert without entering protected geometry.
Install one rear wall-restraint spacer per side on adjacent 50 mm holes with substrate-specific purchased wall anchors before loading.
Do not treat the assembly as manufacturing-, physical-, load-, or release-accepted until all open blockers are closed.

decision_log.topic: Confirm the target FDM process and dimensional compensation
decision_log.current_basis: Approved PETG, 0.6 mm nozzle, 0.68 mm line width, and 0.30 mm structural layer target on a universal 256 mm class printer.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact printer, filament, profile identity, drying state, and process-matched interface coupons.

decision_log.topic: Select and verify substrate-specific wall anchors
decision_log.current_basis: The architecture requires two rear restraints, but anchor capacity belongs to the measured wall substrate and purchased anchor system.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Site substrate identification, exact anchor and screw supplier data, installation method, edge-distance review, and guarded pull/anti-tip test.

decision_log.topic: Qualify the M3 center seam for wide three-column modules
decision_log.current_basis: Modules wider than 245 mm split at center; geometry revision r0.2.0-draft.2 seats each removable 3 mm plate directly on two 6 mm boss tops with zero modeled gap and open coaxial M3 axes.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact M3 insert or captive-nut selection, seam geometry, process coupon, tool access, assembly-cycle, and module-load checks.

decision_log.topic: Verify shelf creep, service load, proof load, and cycle behavior
decision_log.current_basis: The selected 32 mm shelf architecture and two 14 x 32 mm edge beams have only preliminary analytical support.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Production-process shelf assembly tests for creep, service deflection, proof load, residual set, seam behavior, and load cycles.

decision_log.topic: Confirm toilet, service, baseboard, pipe, wall-gap, and floor fit
decision_log.current_basis: The default envelope is approved, but each installation requires measured keep-outs and floor contacts.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Measured site envelope, toilet and lid service path, flush controls, pipes, baseboard, wall gap, floor flatness, and installation mockup.

decision_log.topic: Run the exact target slicer review
decision_log.current_basis: No revision 0.2.0 manufacturing geometry or exact-profile slicer evidence is approved.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact target profile import and toolpath review for bed fit, thin walls, supports, seams, hardware features, and optional relief budget.

decision_log.topic: Complete print-time, material, and manufacturing-mesh optimization evidence
decision_log.current_basis: No stable revision 0.2.0 production geometry, exact slicer baseline, comparison, or selected mesh policy exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Protected-region baseline, process/geometry comparison, selected or no-change decision, mesh policy, and independent slicer-resolution evidence.

decision_log.topic: Integrate and approve the JuSt Innovation watermark on current production geometry
decision_log.current_basis: The specification requires JSI-WM-001-R1 as the last planned solid-geometry feature; no revision 0.2.0 placement or validation evidence exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Current-geometry placement, protected-wall review, readable underside preview, manufacturing validation, and explicit final approval.

validation.method: Run plan_hybrid_design.py against design-plan.json using the supplied acceptance command.
validation.acceptance: Command exits 0 and reports plan integrity PASS with unique IDs, valid references, exact interface ownership, valid transforms, and component envelopes inside the master envelope.

validation.method: Review the revision-bound CAD assembly preview and build manifest for frame, feet, shelves, brackets, modules, decor, wall restraint, and configured keep-outs; measured site keep-outs remain pending.
validation.acceptance: All selected architecture facts and assembly paths are represented without treating the proxy as engineering evidence.

validation.method: Run unit, source, STEP/STL topology, body-count, bounds, bed-fit, and hash checks on the revision-bound DRAFT; process-matched coupons and purchased-part qualification remain pending.
validation.acceptance: Each component meets its recorded count, bounds, material authority, interface ownership, and coupon criteria.

validation.method: Run the revision-bound digital integration checks for assembly identity, collision proxies, hardware axes/stacks, seam seating, drawer travel, module stops, floor contacts, header capture, and wall-restraint geometry; measured site fit and exact tool/hardware access remain pending.
validation.acceptance: No unintended collision or protected-region intrusion and all serviceable assembly paths remain accessible.

validation.method: Run digital mesh and configured bed-fit checks now, then complete exact target slicer, support, thin-wall, 3MF, time/material, mesh-policy, and optimization review on the unchanged DRAFT candidate.
validation.acceptance: All manufacturing blockers are evidenced and closed before any manufacturing acceptance claim.

validation.method: Future process coupons, shelf creep/service/proof/cycle tests, drawer cycle test, floor/site mockup, and substrate-specific guarded anti-tip test; not performed by this edit.
validation.acceptance: All approved physical criteria pass on production-process parts at the measured installation before any load or release claim.
